%sql
-- Silver ETL
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xabf5c.silver_events AS
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY ingested_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.exam_xabf5c.raw_events
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    user_id,
    try_to_timestamp(event_ts) AS event_ts_ts,
    event_type,
    cast(amount as double) AS amount
  FROM dedup
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  event_id,
  user_id,
  event_ts_ts AS event_ts,
  event_type,
  amount
FROM parsed
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_ts_ts IS NOT NULL;

-- Rejects
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xabf5c.silver_rejects AS
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY ingested_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.exam_xabf5c.raw_events
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    user_id,
    try_to_timestamp(event_ts) AS ts
  FROM dedup
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  event_id,
  CASE
    WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'null_user_id'
    WHEN ts IS NULL THEN 'bad_timestamp'
  END AS reject_reason
FROM filtered
WHERE user_id IS NULL OR ts IS NULL;

%sql
-- Gold ETL
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xabf5c.gold_daily AS
SELECT
  date(event_ts) AS event_date,
  count(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users,
  sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchases,
  round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS revenue
FROM workspace.exam_xabf5c.silver_events
GROUP BY date(event_ts);
